product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides CRM-integrated conversational messaging—including SMS and other channels—for businesses using platforms such as Salesforce and Zoho to engage customers in sales, marketing, and support.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes CRM-integrated business messaging for Marketing, Sales, and Support.

pricing_page.notes: Public page displays named plans and billing options, even though prices are not shown.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations appear as case-study customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn-derived company profile indicates 305 employees; this fits the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Company jobs page says it was founded in Pune and remains headquartered there; although LinkedIn lists Henderson, Nevada as its headquarters, the company itself identifies Pune as the HQ.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, industry, how-to, and promotional posts; no evidence of two engineer-authored posts describing how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product guides, FAQs, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The available company careers page lists no specific AI, ML, or data-science postings. It shows an open-positions section but no job titles.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product documentation and searched company material; no model/provider statement was found.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust page explicitly states GDPR compliant; it does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Funding profile says no funding raised; zero amount and blank date are used because there is no round.

raised_18mo.notes: Funding profile reports no outside funding, so no round occurred in the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current LinkedIn job listing dated within the run period is titled SDR - Team Lead.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable company news page's newest listed announcement dates to November 2022 and the blog index's newest post is from November 2025; no product or major-feature launch within the six-month window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated announcement reports Vikas Narang joining as COO, a C-level role, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Documentation identifies Salesforce, Zoho applications, Marketo, and Pardot in its integration/product documentation.
